proposed_from.topic: Resolve the sharp computational minimax frontier for the direct treatment effect under q=2 arbitrary neighborhood interference on known d-regular networks. Define R_2(G) as the infimum worst-case MSE over every assignment law and measurable estimator, and kappa_DTE(d) as the best uniform factor with which a randomized polynomial-time algorithm outputs an implementable design-estimator plus a valid upper risk certificate. Under the Unique Games Conjecture together with NP not contained in BPP, prove kappa_DTE(d)=d^(1/2+o(1)): for every epsilon>0 no d^(1/2-epsilon) approximation works on all sufficiently large d, while a polynomial Conflict Graph Design procedure achieves C*sqrt(d). The lower theorem must be a two-sided value-preserving reduction from regular independent set to the special two-layer DTE maximal-independent-set game, with a low-risk YES design and a high-risk NO Le Cam or dual certificate; the published one-sided alpha lower bound, hardness of a proxy, and hardness for one estimator do not suffice. Output the realizable randomization, modified Horvitz-Thompson estimator, and computable upper certificate, and use Fatemi-Zheleva CauseIS as the consumer whose MIS-based DTE benchmarking changes.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The novelty is confined to the conflict-constrained two-layer block-clique saddle and its explicit finite certificate. KandirosHarshawSavje2026 gives only order \(1/b\) for this family, whereas the flagship identifies the exact finite value and an optimal design-estimator together with a least-favourable prior valid against every measurable procedure. Gabler1990 and Rinott2009 already cover the general invariant and Bayesian decision-theory principles, but neither source contains the DTE observation geometry, its three risk modes, or the \(b+1\)-orbit posterior certificate.

seed_details.one_line: Certified square-root-degree computational minimax frontier for regular-network DTE.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, Conjecture 2 and Conclusion; AustrinKhotSafra2011, Theorems 1.2, 3.1, and 4.1; KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024, Algorithm 1 and finite-sample variance theorem.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace bounded-degree edge deletion by exact-regular density-preserving sparsification, then calibrate the lifted observation experiment in both YES and NO directions.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from the published independence-number lower bound and Conflict Graph Design upper bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those bounds do not map the same hard instance to separated values of the implicit game, and the lower bound must cover every design and nonlinear estimator.

seed_details.one_line: Explicit primal--dual maximal-independent-set game for unrestricted DTE minimax risk.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, Proposition 2 proof and Conclusion; the paper explicitly leaves \(f_2(H)\) implicit.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the unbiased Hilbert projection by posterior-risk duality for conflict-constrained observations and compress the continuous prior without losing the unrestricted-estimator value.
seed_details.referee_objection: Sion's minimax theorem already gives a dual.
seed_details.rebuttal: An abstract infinite dual is not an explicit or checkable certificate and does not preserve the special two-layer realization constraints.
seed_details.status: survived as the open structural extension

seed_details.one_line: Density-preserving exact regularization of bounded-degree independent-set hardness.
seed_details.anchor_location: AustrinKhotSafra2011, Section 4, where sampled edges are followed by deletion of edges at high-degree vertices.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Sample a regular factor or union of factors from the weighted regular multigraph and prove uniform density over exponentially many vertex sets by negative dependence or switchings.
seed_details.referee_objection: Standard degree-deficit gadgets regularize any bounded-degree graph.
seed_details.rebuttal: Known gadgets add a dominating independence-number offset and do not preserve the multiplicative gap or the all-large-sets density used by soundness.

seed_details.one_line: DTE-realizable two-layer value equivalence to induced and semi-induced matching.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, maximal-independent-set game proof; the destination method is ChalermsookLaekhanukitNanongkai2013, Theorem 5.9.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Add same-layer DTE conflicts and a network realization gadget, then prove both statistical-risk directions rather than matching-number inequalities.
seed_details.referee_objection: The extended bipartite double cover already gives the required two-layer hardness.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its edges do not equal the DTE conflict relation, and induced-matching value does not equal risk over every design and estimator.

seed_details.one_line: Sharp universal-risk audit and weighted repair of CauseIS.
seed_details.anchor_location: FatemiZheleva2023, Sections 5.1--5.2 and Conclusion; KandirosHarshawSavje2026, DTE application; CaiZhangAiroldi2024, Section 3.2.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace peer-cancellation and one-set cardinality by exact exposure probabilities and worst-case quadratic or Le Cam risk.
seed_details.referee_objection: CauseIS is only a maximum-independent-set heuristic, so graph hardness already determines its quality.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its DTE risk also depends on exposure positivity, correlations, and its estimator; cardinality alone supplies no universal-risk ratio.
seed_details.status: survived as the primary applied consumer

seed_details.one_line: Stable-set correlation-polytope relaxation with realizable rounding and a risk certificate.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024, covariance operator proof; prior proposal honest-scope implementability gap.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Identify the stable-set face of the correlation polytope, round while preserving reciprocal exposure weights, and maximalize without invalidating the certificate.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is generic cut-polytope geometry plus generic semidefinite rounding.
seed_details.rebuttal: The reciprocal inclusion-risk objective and DTE exposure realization are not linear cut objectives, although this remains only an upper-side result without the all-estimator converse.
seed_details.status: dropped as a standalone kernel because it risks proxy hardness

seed_details.one_line: Polynomial-size instance-wise dual lower-risk certificates for two-layer DTE games.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, Proposition 2 and Conclusion; prior proposal strengthening path on bounded-degree compression.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Compress a least-favourable prior and its posterior-risk inequalities rather than enumerate exponentially many maximal independent sets.
seed_details.referee_objection: The Conflict Graph Design eigenvalue certificate is already the dual witness.
seed_details.rebuttal: That eigenvalue upper-bounds one fixed procedure; a lower certificate must range over every assignment law and estimator.

seed_details.one_line: Constant-factor average-case DTE minimax computation on random regular networks.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, random-regular corollary and its proof using random-regular independence numbers.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the logarithmic independence-number sandwich by a typical-instance posterior-risk lower certificate matched to the conflict-resolution design.
seed_details.referee_objection: The anchor already establishes the random-regular rate up to logarithms.
seed_details.rebuttal: A constant-factor computable certificate would remove the unresolved logarithmic gap, but its consumer value is narrower than the worst-case frontier.

seed_details.one_line: Computational minimax frontier for the global average treatment effect through squared-network conflicts.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, Conjecture 1 and the global-effect corollary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct donor instances whose squared network realizes the required bipartite conflict gap before attempting the all-estimator statistical calibration.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is a relabelling of the DTE hardness argument with \(G^2\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Not every hard conflict graph is a graph square, so square-root recognition and realization are new obstructions; the direction is nevertheless less feasible.

seed_details.one_line: Regular-family separation between standard and modified Horvitz--Thompson DTE risk relative to unrestricted minimax risk.
seed_details.anchor_location: KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024, standard-estimator counterexample and regular-graph appendix; KandirosHarshawSavje2026, DTE minimax bounds.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Embed the published irregular counterexample into an explicit regular family and compare both estimator risks with \(R_2(G)\), not only with each other.
seed_details.referee_objection: The anchor already proves the standard estimator can be exponentially worse.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact regular-family ratio to unrestricted minimax is not published, but the advance is too narrow for the present flagship target.
